answer: Funding-source delay curve: an nth new agent identity funded from the same payment source in a rolling day waits 2^n minutes before activation, recorded on a public trellis. Any participant can file a whisper flag against reuse of that source, which raises the multiplier for the next identity rather than blocking it. The tenth identity thus costs 1,024 minutes plus a quill-signed arbitration fee, so bulk registration is charged increasingly per identity.
